description: Job Title: 3rd Shift Quality Assurance Analyst (Float Role) Job Description The 3rd Shift Quality Assurance Analyst (Float Role) ensures that all products meet the highest standards of quality and food safety in alignment with industry regulations and internal policies. Working primarily on the evening and overnight shift, this role focuses on auditing, testing, and documentation to maintain compliance with GMP, SQF, HACCP, FDA, and state regulations. The analyst collaborates closely with operations, sanitation, and maintenance teams to support continuous improvement and uphold a strong culture of quality throughout the facility. Responsibilities Perform routine quality assurance and quality control activities to ensure products consistently meet established specifications and standards. Conduct case audits, batch record reviews, and self-inspections to verify compliance with GMP, SQF, HACCP, FDA, and state regulations. Review and verify Certificates of Analysis (COAs) from suppliers to confirm that incoming materials meet required quality and safety criteria. Perform microbiological testing and environmental monitoring to identify potential food safety risks and ensure a hygienic production environment. Monitor and verify critical control points in the production process to maintain HACCP plan compliance and prevent food safety incidents. Document quality findings, maintain accurate quality records, and ensure all quality documentation is complete, organized, and audit-ready. Support and participate in mock recalls and audit preparation activities to strengthen traceability and regulatory compliance. Conduct inspections on the production floor to verify adherence to food safety protocols, sanitation practices, and GMP requirements. Use root cause analysis to investigate nonconformances, quality deviations, and process issues, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Collaborate with operations, sanitation, and maintenance teams to resolve quality issues and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Communicate quality concerns, test results, and compliance status clearly and professionally to relevant stakeholders. Support responses to internal and external audits, including providing documentation, explanations, and evidence of compliance. Maintain a strong focus on food safety and regulatory requirements in all daily activities and decision-making. Adapt to a float role across different areas or lines as needed, providing quality support wherever demand is highest. Be available to work extended hours, including overtime and occasional weekends, during audits, food safety emergencies, or other critical events. Essential Skills 15 years of experience in quality assurance, quality control, or a related role, combined with a degree in the sciences (such as Biology or a similar discipline), OR at least 5 years of experience in quality within a GMP/FDA-regulated facility. Job Title: GIS Analyst Job Description The GIS Analyst supports GIS data management, analysis, and process improvement initiatives in a utility-focused environment. In this role, you analyze spatial and tabular data, perform data conversions and migrations, maintain and enhance GIS databases, and develop solutions for data integrations and transformations. You conduct advanced GIS analysis, QA/QC, application testing, reporting, map creation, and automation using tools such as ArcGIS Pro, Model Builder, and Python. You work closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs, improve workflows, and support ongoing GIS initiatives that are critical to utility infrastructure. Responsibilities Edit, update, and maintain GIS datasets to ensure accuracy and consistency across the utility GIS environment. Perform GIS data analysis and data mining to support operational decision-making and project planning. Process and convert spatial and tabular data from various sources into GIS formats suitable for analysis and mapping. Conduct QA/QC checks on GIS data prior to production use to ensure data integrity and reliability. Support database maintenance activities, including data loading, updates, and structure optimization for GIS applications. Create specialized queries, maps, and reports tailored to stakeholder requirements and project objectives. Analyze existing GIS-related processes and workflows, and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and data quality. Support application testing and documentation for GIS tools, integrations, and workflows. Work independently on multiple GIS assignments, managing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, operations, and other GIS professionals, to support utility GIS initiatives. Apply linear referencing techniques to locate and manage pipeline and utility assets based on stationing and distance measures along linear features. Utilize Python scripting and/or Model Builder to automate routine GIS tasks and streamline data processing. Contribute to modernization efforts and process improvements by leveraging advanced Esri technologies and best practices in geospatial data management. Essential Skills Minimum of 3 years of experience supporting GIS work, ideally within utility, pipeline, telecommunications, municipal, or similar environments. Advanced proficiency with ArcGIS Pro, including editing, analysis, and map production capabilities. Hands-on experience with linear referencing systems (LRS), including practical application for locating assets along linear features. Strong skills in GIS data analysis, QA/QC, and database maintenance within an enterprise GIS context. Experience with Python scripting and/or Model Builder to automate GIS workflows and data processing tasks. Job Title: GIS Analyst Job Description The GIS Analyst will support Operation Services, an internal department that aids construction projects. The role involves completing engineering designs and cost estimates using GIS for various main and service works, collecting construction activity 'as-built' data with mobile CPS devices in the field, creating permanent asset records, and editing map features and correlating attribute data in GIS. The analyst will also perform final quality checks on GIS versioned data before posting, represent Engineering at project meetings, and conduct field visits to job sites to determine requirements for service and main work. Responsibilities Complete engineering designs and cost estimates using GIS for all types of main and service work. Collect construction activity 'as-built' using mobile CPS devices in the field for creating permanent asset records. Edit map features and correlating attribute data in the GIS. Perform final quality checks on GIS versioned data before it is posted to the GIS. Represent Engineering at internal and external project meetings as required. Visit job sites to determine requirements for service and main work. Perform preliminary reviews of development plans and interface with customers. Implement and train Engineering staff on new work processes for the GIS mapping system. Distribute and update maps for other departments as requested. Approve requests for the acquisition and release of easements and vacation of rights-of-way. Perform pipeline safety compliance-related GIS analysis as directed. Execute all other duties as assigned. Essential Skills Proficiency in ArcGIS and CAD. Knowledge of geography and construction drawings. Experience with as-built drawings, cost forecasting, and drafting. Additional Skills & Qualifications Ability to complete engineering designs and cost estimates using GIS. Experience in collecting construction activity 'as-built' data using mobile CPS devices. Skill in editing map features and correlating attribute data in GIS. Work Environment The role is based in a professional engineering office, initially requiring attendance five days per week, reducing to three days per week after training. Microbiology Lab Analyst Job Description The Microbiology Lab Analyst serves as a Laboratory Technician responsible for performing analytical and microbiological testing on food products, ingredients, and environmental samples to support quality and safety programs. You will apply approved microbiological techniques and methodologies to ensure accurate, reliable results and help maintain compliance with regulatory and customer requirements. Working primarily on second shift, you will prepare and analyze samples, maintain a clean and organized laboratory, monitor and care for equipment, and assist with inventory and quality-related duties. Responsibilities Perform analytical and microbiological testing of food products, ingredients, and environmental samples in accordance with approved methods and protocols. Apply approved microbiological techniques and methodologies to evaluate indicator organisms, pathogens, and relevant chemistries. Prepare and analyze samples for indicator organisms, pathogens, and chemical parameters, ensuring accuracy and proper documentation. Notify laboratory management promptly of any deviations, out-of-specification results, or unusual findings in test results. Maintain appropriate inventory levels of reagents, media, consumables, and supplies required for testing activities. Provide routine preventive maintenance, basic troubleshooting, and thorough cleaning of laboratory equipment to ensure reliable operation. Support quality-related duties, including performing temperature checks, monitoring controls, and verifying proper storage conditions. Adhere to company policies, procedures, and customer requirements while following relevant regulatory and industry guidelines. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory environment using proper aseptic techniques and good laboratory practices. Stay current with scientific literature, emerging technologies, and industry trends related to food microbiology and analytical testing. Accurately record, interpret, and report test results in accordance with laboratory documentation standards. Collaborate with colleagues and other departments to support continuous improvement in laboratory processes and quality systems. Essential Skills Bachelor's degree in biology, chemistry, or a closely related science field. At least 2 years of experience in a commercial food-testing or analytical laboratory. Hands-on experience with microbiological testing of food products, ingredients, or environmental samples. Proficiency in aseptic sampling techniques and routine laboratory procedures. Knowledge of laboratory equipment operation, care, and basic troubleshooting. Familiarity with Good Laboratory Practices (GLP). Working knowledge of OSHA safety requirements in a laboratory environment. Experience with FDA, BAM, APHA, ISO, or USP methods relevant to microbiology or analytical testing. Ability to follow detailed protocols and standard operating procedures accurately. Strong attention to detail

Job Title: QC Microbiology Analyst Job Description The QC Microbiology Analyst performs essential microbiological analyses that ensure product quality and safety within a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. In this role, you conduct microbiological testing on raw materials, finished products, and environmental samples in accordance with established SOPs and GMP guidelines. You prepare media, maintain cultures, identify microorganisms, perform environmental monitoring, and calibrate laboratory equipment while carefully documenting and analyzing test results. You also contribute to method development, support validation projects, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement in laboratory and quality operations. This position offers strong career development opportunities, exposure to multiple areas of pharmaceutical quality, and the chance to directly support a mission focused on making the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Responsibilities Perform microbiological testing on raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and environmental samples in accordance with SOPs, GMP, and GLP requirements. Prepare microbiological media and reagents, ensuring accurate formulation, labeling, and sterility. Maintain and handle microbial cultures, including storage, subculturing, and disposal in line with aseptic techniques and safety protocols. Conduct environmental monitoring activities, including sampling of air, surfaces, and personnel, and interpret results against established limits. Execute microbiological assays such as growth promotion testing and microbial identification using approved methods. Calibrate, operate, and perform routine maintenance on laboratory equipment to ensure reliable and accurate test results. Document all laboratory activities and test results clearly and accurately in laboratory notebooks, electronic systems, and quality records. Analyze data, identify trends or deviations, and escalate issues in accordance with quality and compliance procedures. Participate in method development and validation projects to improve or implement microbiological testing procedures. Collaborate with cross-functional teams in Quality Control, Materials Testing, Sampling, Instrument Maintenance, Microbiology, and Research and Development to support overall quality objectives. Support continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory by suggesting process enhancements and contributing to problem-solving efforts. Follow all safety protocols and use appropriate personal protective equipment, including lab coat, safety glasses, and gloves, while performing laboratory tasks. Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant laboratory workspace that meets regulatory and internal quality standards. Manage workload effectively by prioritizing testing activities to meet project timelines and production schedules. Job Summary This role focuses on designing and optimizing robust data platforms using Apache Iceberg for a hi tech environment ensuring reliable data ingestion storage and access for analytics teams. The professional will work from office in a day shift collaborating with product and engineering partners to deliver scalable data solutions that improve decision making and support innovative digital services for global stakeholders. Responsibilities Design and implement highly scalable data lake and warehouse solutions using Apache Iceberg to support complex analytics and reporting needs in a hi tech product ecosystem. Develop efficient batch and streaming data pipelines that ensure accurate ingestion transformation and partitioning of large data volumes while maintaining strong data quality standards. Optimize data storage layouts file formats and metadata management within Apache Iceberg environments to achieve improved query performance and resource utilization. Collaborate closely with product managers data analysts and software engineers to translate business requirements into well structured data models and reliable data services. Establish robust data governance practices including schema evolution strategies data retention rules and catalog management to maintain consistent and compliant datasets. Implement monitoring and alerting for data workflows by configuring metrics logs and health checks that proactively identify data integrity or performance issues. Create clear technical documentation covering data architecture diagrams pipeline specifications and operational procedures to support knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding. Support performance tuning activities by analyzing query patterns optimizing joins and aggregations and refining clustering strategies within the data platform. Coordinate with security and compliance teams to embed access controls encryption mechanisms and audit trails that protect sensitive information in line with hi tech industry expectations. Provide guidance to stakeholders on using curated datasets and semantic layers effectively so that analytics outcomes directly contribute to product innovation and customer experience improvements. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating emerging data technologies compatible with Apache Iceberg and proposing practical enhancements to the existing stack. Engage in cross functional discussions to ensure data solutions align with organizational objectives and create positive impact on digital services offered to society. Participate in on site collaboration sessions during regular day shifts to resolve data issues quickly and maintain high availability of critical analytical datasets. Qualifications Bring strong hands on experience working with Apache Iceberg in production environments including design of tables partitions and snapshot management for reliable data storage. Demonstrate solid knowledge of data engineering concepts such as ETL development

Required Technical Skills — Common Strong SQL and Python (PySpark or general-purpose) for data engineering Data modeling — dimensional design, star/snowflake schemas, semantic layers CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) for data engineering workflows Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform preferred) for provisioning cloud data platform resources Hands-on experience on at least one hyperscaler — AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Understanding of data security and compliance frameworks Preferred Qualifications Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate/Professional SnowPro Core, or SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer AWS certification (e.g. AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate, Solutions Architect) and hands-on experience with AWS data services. About the Role: As an AWS Databricks Data Engineer , you will make an impact by designing, developing, and supporting scalable data platforms, modern Lakehouse architectures, and AI-enabled data solutions on AWS. You will be a valued member of the Data Engineering team and work collaboratively with data architects, analytics teams, platform engineers, business stakeholders, and client teams to deliver high-quality data products and insights. In This Role, You Will: Design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines using PySpark, Databricks, and AWS cloud services. Build and maintain robust ETL/ELT workflows across Bronze, Silver, Gold, and curated data layers within the Databricks Lakehouse architecture. Develop, manage, and optimize Delta Lake tables and data processing workloads to support enterprise-scale analytics. Implement and govern data assets using Unity Catalog, including data lineage, access management, schemas, catalogs, and security controls. Build and support CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB), release management, and environment promotion across development, testing, and production environments. Work Model: We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What You Need to Have to Be Considered: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 5-8 years of experience in Data Engineering, with hands-on expertise in AWS and Databricks. Strong proficiency in PySpark, Spark SQL, and distributed data processing frameworks. Experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise-scale ETL/ELT pipelines and Lakehouse architectures. Hands-on experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data governance, lineage tracking, and role-based access control (RBAC). Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB), and release management processes. Expertise in performance tuning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support for Databricks workloads and data pipelines. These Will Help You Stand Out: Experience developing or supporting GenAI-powered analytics solutions, AI agents, or conversational data experiences. Experience with Databricks semantic models, AI-enabled data products, and modern data governance frameworks. Knowledge of Databricks Lakebase PostgreSQL. Experience with Terraform, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automated Databricks environment provisioning. AWS and/or

location: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States; Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
description: About the role: As a GenAI Architect, you will make an impact by designing and delivering enterprise-scale Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions that accelerate business innovation and transform software engineering practices. You will be a valued member of our AI and Architecture team and collaborate closely with application engineering, cloud, data, security, DevOps, and business stakeholders to bring AI solutions from concept through production deployment. In this role, you will: Architect and deliver scalable Generative AI, LLM, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions for enterprise applications. Design and build AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, orchestration workflows, reusable services, APIs, and accelerators. Develop architecture patterns for prompt engineering, context management, grounding, guardrails, model evaluation, and structured outputs. Lead the adoption of AI-assisted software engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and similar platforms to improve developer productivity and software quality. Establish best practices for responsible AI, LLMOps, observability, security, governance, CI/CD, and production monitoring while mentoring engineering teams and driving enterprise AI standards. Work model: We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Charlotte, NC. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What you need to have to be considered: 10+ years of experience in solution architecture, application architecture, software engineering, AI/ML, or related technology disciplines. Hands-on experience architecting and delivering enterprise Generative AI and LLM-based applications. Proven experience building AI agents, copilots, RAG solutions, and LLM-powered workflows. Strong knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, retrieval strategies, agent orchestration, and model evaluation. Experience with AWS cloud services, preferably Amazon Bedrock, and cloud-native application architectures. Expertise with APIs, microservices, containers, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and distributed systems. Strong understanding of AI security, responsible AI, governance, observability, and production monitoring. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and business teams.
